interpretation: Working minimum for the owner's expanded request: hundreds of substantive topics and thousands of high-quality insights in each subject. Counts do not establish completeness or qualify records for admission.
topic_counting: Report registered, populated, and initial-neighborhood topics separately. Empty source assignments do not satisfy the populated-topic target.
insight_counting: Count unique visible contributions by their primary subject; shared navigational membership does not multiply the global or subject insight total.
relationships: Admit only independently warranted relationships; no relationship quota.
